title: Design System: Laguna College ITE Academic Advising

display.purpose: Sign-in statement only; 2rem on phones, 2.75rem from md.

headline.purpose: Subject of the screen (student name, record); 1.75rem on phones, 2rem from md.

body.purpose: Default reading text, 70ch max for descriptions.

label.purpose: Status tags, column headers (500), metadata, provenance.

figure.purpose: All comparable numbers: units, grades, counts, student numbers.

stamp-word.purpose: Uppercase decision word in the dean stamp only.

stamp-meta.purpose: Office and date lines inside the stamp.

shadows.name: active-nav-ring
shadows.purpose: Hairline ring on the active sidebar item (not a drop shadow).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Button press (140ms), stamp press-in (320ms), content enter (220ms, 6px rise).

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Sheet and drawer slide (280ms); backdrop fades 220ms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations to 1ms; stamp fades 200ms; sheet cross-fades 160ms; press scale removed

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Advising Passbook"**

The system is an academic ledger kept on cool paper. Rule-based results are printed as ledger entries: ruled tables, mono tabular figures, double-ruled totals. Human decisions are the only thing rendered as ink, in the form of the dean's seal-blue stamp. AI explanations live apart, as margin notes set off by a single hairline, never inside the ledger. Every result says where it came from (rule, dean, registrar, assistant), and the visual vocabulary keeps those four voices physically distinct.

Density is operational, not airy: 15px body, 40px controls, tables that fill their panels edge to edge. Containers are one level deep, hairline-edged and flat. The palette is a cool neutral ground with one accent (seal blue, from the Laguna College seal) and a set of status tones that only ever appear inside icon+text tags or map marks. The system explicitly refuses the generic card-and-metric admin dashboard: no KPI tiles, no stacked shadowed cards, no gradient headers.

Light and dark themes are both first-class; dark is a deep blue-black ledger (`#0d1120` paper) with lifted status tones, selected by OS preference or an explicit `data-theme` toggle.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper ground, white hairline panels, no decorative shadows.
Ruled ledger tables with mono tabular figures and a double rule above totals.
One accent, seal blue, used for primary actions, current-term markers, and the dean's stamp.
Status always carried by icon + text (tags) or shape + fill (map marks), never colour alone.
Three voices kept apart: printed ledger (rules), stamp (dean), margin note (assistant).

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Seal blue is the only accent. It marks action, the current term, and the dean's decision; it is never used for decoration, data visualisation, or status of a rule result.

rules.name: The Paired Tone Rule
rules.body: Every status colour exists as a foreground/tint pair and appears only inside a tag (with its icon) or a map mark (with its shape). A status colour on its own, as a bar, dot, or text colour without an icon, is not part of the system.

rules.name: The Violet Means Data Rule
rules.body: Record violet is reserved for missing or incorrect maintained data. It never signals an academic outcome.

rules.name: The Mono Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number a user might compare (units, grades, counts, student numbers, totals) and every subject code is set in Geist Mono with tabular figures. Prose numbers in sentences stay in Geist.

rules.name: The Uppercase Belongs To The Stamp Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked lettering is the stamp's voice. Headings, labels, and column headers stay in sentence case.

rules.name: The Hairline Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Panels are separated by a 1px `line` border on `surface`; they never cast a shadow. The active nav item is lifted with a 1px ring of `line`, not a drop shadow.

rules.name: The One Level Rule
rules.body: A panel never contains another bordered panel. Inside a panel, structure comes from rules (row borders, header rule, double-ruled totals).

dos: **Do** set every comparable number and every subject code in Geist Mono with tabular figures.
**Do** carry status with an icon + text tag or a shape-encoded map mark, using the tone pairs as defined.
**Do** attach a provenance line wherever a rule result, dean decision, registrar record, or AI explanation could be confused.
**Do** close totals with the 3px double rule and open semester groups with the 2px ink top rule.
**Do** keep panels flat: 1px `line` border, 10px corners, `surface` on `paper`.
**Do** use ink (not seal) for selection states in tabs and filter chips.
**Do** render a dean decision exactly once: the stamp plus one dated line.
donts: **Don't** build metric tiles, KPI cards, or a card-and-metric dashboard; the record is a ledger.
**Don't** put a shadow on a panel, row, or card; the overlay shadow is for sheets and the drawer only.
**Don't** use seal blue for anything that is not an action, the current term, or a dean decision.
**Don't** render rule results or AI text as a stamp, or put AI explanations inside a ledger or panel; they are margin notes.
**Don't** signal status by colour alone (coloured text, dots, or bars without icon or shape).
**Don't** use uppercase tracked lettering outside the stamp.
